issue.title: Decision log for Release bot merge plans
issue.description:
Attach a pstack show-me-your-work TSV log (decision, why, evidence, result) to every merge plan.

## Design (Oct 16, plan §6) · build with model:opus

* **Bottom-up landing:** a merge plan lands only the contiguous verified run of a stack, bottom-up. It stops at the first PR without a valid [OVD-845](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-845/automerge-eligible-check) verdict for its current SHA.
* **Read-back of every merge:** after each merge, read `main` back and assert that `git rev-parse <merge_commit>^{tree}` == the tree of the verified head (or, after a rebase, the patch-id is identical and the tree equals the verified-head tree rebased onto the parent). "A queued merge or an armed auto-merge is not a merge": the PR state alone is never enough.
* The append-only TSV decision log (`ts, pr, head_sha, patch_id, verdict_ref, action, merge_sha, tree_match, result`) records each read-back. `tree_match=false` stops the run and gets flagged to Grok Bot/Blaine (no auto-revert).

## Test plan

A git fixture repo: a squash merge with an identical tree gives true; a tampered or extra commit gives false and stops; a stack of 3 with the middle one unverified lands only the bottom one; the log is append-only (a rewrite is detected).

parent.title: pstack auto-merge
parent.description:
Goal: get Overdrafter PRs to merge automatically, using @poteto's pstack tools and mechanical proof instead of manual approval.

**Blaine's decision (2026-10-16): live database changes stay manual.** Prod migrations and prod DB applies always need Blaine's OK. Branch protection changes need his approval card.

Plan: /workspace/plans/pstack-automerge.md (on the box).

Order (updated Oct 16 per plan §6): verify-overdrafter skill ([OVD-842](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-842/create-the-verify-overdrafter-verification-skill)) → verify in CI ([OVD-843](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-843/run-the-verify-skill-in-ci-at-the-head-sha)) → proof-check ([OVD-841](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-841/build-scriptsproof-checkmjs-and-run-it-as-a-ci-check)) → merge queue ([OVD-854](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-854/merge-queue-or-strict-branch-protection-on-main)) → sensitive-class detector ([OVD-844](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-844/sensitive-class-detector-for-prs)) + verdict schema/emitter ([OVD-851](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-851/standard-review-verdict-format)) → automerge-eligible ([OVD-845](https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-845/automerge-eligible-check)). The merge gate needs an independent verifier's PASS bound to the head SHA (patch-id carry-over after a rebase), every merge is read back (tree == verified head), and any gate-loosening change needs a Grok Bot countersign on top of Blaine's card.

nodes.body: Plan §6 added (model:opus): land the stack bottom-up, only the contiguous verified run. Read back every merge (merged tree == verified head) and record `tree_match` in the append-only TSV. A mismatch stops the run.
